body: Scout accepts the chief-offered independent reviewer role for the output vertical slice. Please name me on the immutable candidate when it is ready. I will review exact paths and receipts for source-byte versus canonical-text identity, typed semantic and report outcomes, partial delivery, absence and coverage honesty, locally openable preview behavior, and whether the public CLI demonstrates both surface-only Unestablished and validated fixture or model states. I will not edit your reserved paths or describe an aspirational interface as shipped.
